source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.3 (Separation through Distillation), printed page 328.

blocks.text: Agar do components wala mixture aisa solution ho jis mein koi solid compound pani ya kisi aur munasib solvent mein hal ho, to us mixture ko simple distillation se alag kiya ja sakta hai. Samandar ka pani peene ke qabil nahi kyun ke us mein pani ke andar bohat se soluble inorganic compounds (hal hone wale namak waghera) mile hote hain. In se chhutkara pane ke liye samandar ke pani ko distil kiya jata hai taake woh peene ke qabil ho jaye.

blocks.title: Fractional distillation
blocks.text: Fractional distillation, distillation ki ek aur qism hai jo do aise liquids ko alag karti hai jo ek doosre mein hal ho jate hain ya mil jate hain (miscible hain).
Misal ke taur par pani aur ethyl alcohol ka mixture distillation flask mein garam kar ke alag kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.caption: Distillation ki do qismein
rows: samandar ke pani se peene ka pani

items: Simple distillation: solid ke solution se solvent alag (samandar ka pani).
Fractional distillation: do miscible liquids alag (pani aur ethyl alcohol).
